definitions.explanation: Additional news or information that follows an initial report on the same topic. Common in journalism and news media.

examples.japanese: {続報|ぞくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will report as soon as further news comes in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{続報|ぞくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting for a follow-up report on the incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{続報|ぞくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A follow-up report on the typhoon damage was released.

notes:
USAGE:
A news and media term. The phrase {続報|ぞくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧ (as soon as further news comes in) is a standard journalistic expression heard on TV news and in online reporting.

FORMS:
{続|ぞく} (continue, follow) + {報|ほう} (report, news).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: breaking news, flash report
- {第一報|だいいっぽう}: first report, initial news
- ⟦{詳報|しょうほう}→詳報：16454_shouhou⟧: detailed report

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {続報|ぞくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: further news comes in
- {続報|ぞくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: wait for an update
- {続報|ぞくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧: as soon as there is an update
